description:
crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs has a #[cfg(test)] mod tests with three json_merge_patch tests (depth cap, shallow apply, and the new absent-field regression added in bd:JMAP-sc1b.87).

The other four siblings with the same json_merge_patch implementation (calendars, contacts, sharing, tasks) have no test module at all in memory.rs, so the same regressions could land in any of them undetected.

Cookie-cutter sweep: propagate the chat-server tests module (or extract json_merge_patch into a shared helper module). The implementations in all 5 siblings are byte-for-byte identical — there is no per-sibling reason for the divergence in test coverage.
title: P3: 4 sibling MemoryBackends lack json_merge_patch tests that chat-server has
